cytochrome_guards.how_to_read: refused_by_resolved_alias counts probes whose array symbol is not a cytochrome but whose resolved gene is. Excluding by array symbol alone would leave those probes in the regulons.

reasons.F1/F2/F5: the target enzyme has no admissible probe, so no arm carrying its transcript can be built; this is not a negative result

signed_network_audit.how_to_read: dropped_cytochrome_target is the circularity guard at the edge level; it must be positive on the real network, because every study enzyme has recorded regulators.

arms.F1: F0 + the target enzyme's own transcript (primary comparator)
arms.F2: F1 + the evaluable regulators' own transcripts
arms.F4p: F0 + regulator activities from cytochrome-free regulons

coefficient_sign_agreement.what_it_is_not: Sign agreement is a statement about direction, not about prediction. It never upgrades the predictive block, and a model can agree with every recorded sign while predicting no better than the transcript alone.

UBP1.reason: no regulon survived the sign and cytochrome rules
no regulon survived the sign and cytochrome rules

clinical_pk_transfer_reason: This cohort has no dose, no concentration and no time. Nothing here was scaled to a clearance or an exposure, and no simulated concentration appears in this artefact. Closing the chain needs individual transcriptome and individual concentration-time pharmacokinetics in the same publicly downloadable subjects, which the project's registry does not contain.
how_to_read_runtime: runtime_seconds is wall clock and therefore includes any time the process spent suspended, which on a laptop can exceed the computation by two orders of magnitude. fold_cumulative_seconds is the cumulative time at the end of each outer fold and is the figure to read for cost: a fold that took far longer than its neighbours did not do more work. Neither number affects any result -- the run is fully determined by the frozen seeds.

predictive_performance.control_reading: A gain the rewired null reproduces is refuted by its own control. Flat performance across sign_perturbation fractions means any gain came from the gene list, not from the signs.

key_secondary_contrasts.how_to_read: delta_mae negative means the first arm has the smaller error. interval_excludes_zero false means no difference was DETECTED, never that there is none. Success needs all three of: relative reduction at least the frozen threshold, interval excluding zero, and no reversal on both robustness co-criteria.
